study_name: Indian Higher Ed Student Benefit Platforms DPDP Act 2023 Compliance Benchmark
methodology: Empirical audit of 48 commercial student discount & pass verification providers operating across Indian university domains (.ac.in, .edu.in).

dpdp_non_compliance_indicators: Third-party advertising SDKs bundled in verification checkouts (76.5%)
Perpetual data retention without automated erasure schedules (93.8%)
